title: Security
intro: Rogue DHCP servers, ARP spoofing, MAC flapping, loops and broadcast storms, as the security plugins see them. Each finding points at a switch port and, where Floorbit can tell, a seat.
none: Nothing found. The security plugins are watching.
noPlugins: No security plugin is on yet. Turn one on under Settings > Plugins.
shutText: The port stays down until someone turns it on again here. Whoever is connected to it loses their connection.
reason: Why (shown in the list of shut ports)
loginHint: Used for this one connection and never stored. The action is in the audit log under your name.
